acceptancePolicy: Reusable rules primitives and their cross-system interactions are the release target. Unknown/unusual runtime behavior fails closed with explicit unsupported diagnostics rather than being silently approximated.
fixedDuringRelease: Counter/token provenance now reports source card instance identity consistently.
Priority/invariant handling now permits the active player to be eliminated during stack resolution and skips that eliminated player correctly.
Compiler 1.3 now composes multiple independently exact Oracle ability paragraphs through the generic card-script path while remaining fail-closed on unknown/ambiguous text.
Stale generated support metadata was rebuilt, restoring the intended 31 golden-certified fully-supported cards.
